description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the CandidateMarkingInterviewFailAPI within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It tests the API's methods such as getOne, getValidationRuleForGetOne, update, delete, and getValidationRuleForDelete, mainly asserting that some methods throw NotImplemented exceptions and performing data-driven tests for the update method.

methods.description: Tests that the getOne method of the API throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.description: Tests that the getValidationRuleForGetOne method throws a NotImplementedException.
